violation_type.title: Doors to Restroom - Locks Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §746.4421(1))
violation_type.short_title: Doors to Restroom - Locks Out of Children's Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: The restrooms in Preschool 1 and Preschool 2 classrooms had locks on the door handles that children could reach.
